evidence.title: OpenShaders: Shaders belong on the web

name: About OpenShaders
summary: Letter explaining OpenShaders, a pre-launch home for WebGL and WebGPU shaders and the people who make them.
description: Founder's letter about OpenShaders: a community site where shader authors publish, save, upvote and follow each other, building their work in a live WebGL or WebGPU editor and collaborating when a piece needs more than one pair of hands. It states the goal of building a large collection of shaders that are easy to find, customize and use in real websites; usernames can be claimed before launch.
contains: a home for shaders and their authors
live editor for building shaders in WebGL or WebGPU
usernames can be claimed before launch
